_comment: The act layer. Acts are a COUNTER-DERIVED quest-machinery layer (progress = pure function of counters, the WIQuests idiom), evaluated by WIActs (src/core/acts.gd), NOT stored. The CURRENT act is the highest act whose predecessors' `advance_when` gates are all met (fresh boot = Act I; capped at the last act -- Act III is open-ended until the A3 climax banks `raskghar_sealed`, so its gate stays defined-but-unreachable for now). Conditions share one predicate shape used by both `advance_when` (advance to the next act) and per-beat `when` (journal milestone achieved): `min_classes` (int, classes.size()), `quests_completed` (int, count of COMPLETED started quests via WIQuests), `accomplishments` ({id: min_count}). Empty condition = trivially met. All copy is RESULTS-ONLY and opaque (no stats, canon-warm) per the design + repo constraint. act_ii's advance gate + its `known_face` beat key off the MONOTONIC `reached_two_classes` accomplishment (banked once the PC first holds two classes; see WIGame._bank_reached_two_classes_if_earned) rather than the live `min_classes: 2` -- a Spellsword consolidation (2 classes -> 1) must never un-advance Act II or lock Act III. `min_classes` (still supported by the predicate) is used only where it is monotone-safe (act_i's `min_classes: 1`, which the classless->first-class transition never reverses).

Krshia trusts you with more than gossip now.
The Watch knows to call on you when something's wrong.

The seal holds. Liscor counts you among its own.
